formal_statement: ∃ (n m : ℕ) (S : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)) (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin m → ℕ) (i0 : Fin gates.length) (hw : ℕ) (T : Finset (Fin n)) (t0 : Fin n), (∀ i : Fin m, 2 ≤ (S i).card) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin m, i ≠ j → (S i ∩ S j).card ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ q : Fin gates.length, (gates.get q).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → q = i0) ∧ (gates.get i0).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ (gates.get i0).inputs.head? = some hw ∧ (hw < n + i0.val) ∧ (∀ (o : Fin m) (x : Fin n → Bool), PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out o⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ S o, x v = true)) ∧ (∀ y : Fin n → Bool, (∀ t ∈ T, y t = false) → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, hw⟩ (List.ofFn y) = false) ∧ (t0 ∈ T) ∧ (∀ t ∈ T, (Finset.univ.filter (fun a : Fin m => t ∈ S a)).card ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun b : Fin m => t0 ∈ S b)).card) ∧ gates.length + ∑ u ∈ T.erase t0, (Finset.univ.filter (fun c : Fin m => u ∈ S c)).card < 1 + ∑ s : Fin m, ((S s).card - 1)
plain_statement: Are there sets S_1..S_m of n inputs, each of at least 2, two sharing at most one input, with deg t the number of sets holding t, and a list of AND, OR and NOT gates on at most two wires, exactly one NOT gate, reading an earlier wire h, giving the OR of each set on every input, with T inputs such that h is false whenever all of T is false and t0 of largest degree in T, where the list has fewer than 1 + sum of (|S_i| - 1) - sum over t in T other than t0 of deg t gates? Wanted: such a list. Conjecture that none exists; none found by script.
title: Search: a counterexample to the clause lemma for one NOT gate on Boolean sums of sets sharing pairwise at most one input
